limitations: Historical 2020 comparison at fourteen days; no 2026 House forecast.
Shares condition on D/R votes in 383 eligible districts. All 435 group probabilities are a separate linked product.
Usable polling covers 82 of 435 districts (146 selected polls). Unpolled races can update through the shared national factor.
Final archive and candidate rosters are retrospective proxies. Cutoff uses field end and aggregator ingestion plus one day; original publication dates mostly unverified.
Error scales fitted using strictly earlier House elections; covariance parameter uncertainty is not integrated. Source-date, scale and sample-dependence sensitivities are supplied.
The aggregate D/R polling law is not a turnout, candidate-count, undecided-transition or exact ranked-choice/runoff model.
Race numerical precision is conditional on saved model banks. Public chamber control and tipping forecasts remain unqualified.
Revisited development comparisons do not establish prospective performance.
